options: Enhancing security cooperation and countering radicalization
questions.explain: Securing regional stability has become a top priority for Delhi, given the potential for the spillover of militancy from Afghanistan. That's precisely why our 'Connect Central Asia' policy places such high value on security and connectivity.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: The 'Connect Central Asia' policy, which gained major momentum under PM Modi’s 2015 visit, includes which of the following countries?
options: Kazakhstan, Kyrgyz Republic, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan
Kyrgyz Republic, Mongolia, Uzbekistan, Turkmenistan, Tajikistan
questions.explain: These five nations constitute the core of our extended neighborhood outreach strategy. You'll often see these nations discussed in the context of the SCO, where India actively engages in counter-terrorism discussions.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: Why is the INSTC (International North-South Transport Corridor) critical for India’s engagement with Central Asia?
options: It exclusively handles petroleum shipments from Russia
It is the only railway route funded by China
It offers a workaround for the lack of direct land access due to Pakistan
It provides a sea route through the Arctic Ocean
questions.explain: Because our northern land routes are obstructed by Pakistan, we're relying on projects like Chabahar in Iran to link up with the corridor. It’s a vital strategic move to ensure we aren't cut off from the region's immense mineral potential.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: How do researchers define a 'glacial collapse' in terms of its mechanism?
options: A slow melting process of snow packs
A gravity-driven detachment of ice and debris from mountain slopes
A result of subterranean volcanic activity
A controlled release of glacier runoff
questions.explain: These are violent, sudden events where large masses break away and turn into high-speed flows of ice and earth. Scientists find them particularly dangerous because they often lack the rainfall warnings typical of other flood types.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: Which of the following is true about the 'wet-base' glaciers found in the Himalayas?
options: They are completely frozen to the bedrock
They have been scientifically proven to be immune to collapse
They sit on layers of soft mud or clay with water trapped beneath
They exist only at elevations below 1,000 meters
questions.explain: Because they rest on unstable, saturated material, these glaciers can become remarkably fluid when stressed. This geological detail is a major focus of studies on Himalayan flood risk management.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: What is the primary objective of the NaBFID (National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development)?
options: Addressing long-term funding gaps in India's infrastructure sector
Offering consumer credit for household appliances
Providing subsidized agricultural loans to small farmers
Managing the foreign exchange reserves of the country
questions.explain: Created by a 2021 Parliamentary Act, this institution is essentially built to catalyze infrastructure investment. It’s regulated as an All-India Financial Institution by the RBI, which gives it a unique standing in our financial sector.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: Under the PRIP scheme, which component aims to establish Centers of Excellence in NIPERs?
questions.explain: The scheme focuses heavily on industry-academia bridges, with Component A specifically dedicated to boosting research infrastructure in the seven NIPER campuses. It's a key initiative under the Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers to make India an R&D powerhouse.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: What is the key technological innovation behind the 'Pusa Rice DST1' variety?
options: Enhanced pest resistance through GMO techniques
Improved yield using cross-breeding with imported seeds
Genome editing of the DST gene for drought and salt tolerance
questions.explain: This rice variant is a classic example of modern precision breeding, specifically designed for tricky soil and moisture conditions. Note that genome editing is distinct from traditional GMO methods because it works on the plant's existing genetic framework.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: What is a unique historical connection between India and Uzbekistan mentioned in current reports?
options: Shared linguistic heritage with thousands of common words and ancient monastic links
Shared border treaties dating back to the Kushan era
Joint ownership of maritime trade routes
Uniform currency systems in ancient history
questions.explain: The discovery of a Buddhist monastery at Kara Tepa highlights our ancient religious footprint in the region. Plus, it's fascinating to see linguistic commonalities—like the shared word for 'samosa'—that have persisted for centuries.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: Which group of countries does Kuwait belong to?
questions.explain: Being a key member of the Gulf Cooperation Council and OPEC makes it a central player in regional and global energy geopolitics. Keep in mind its location on the tip of the Persian Gulf, which shapes much of its strategic maritime identity.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: What is a noteworthy feature of sesame as an indigenous crop?
options: It has historical roots dating back to the Indus Valley Civilization
It is a hybrid variety introduced recently
It can only be grown in humid tropical regions
It is an aquatic plant species
questions.explain: Archeological finds in Harappa and Mohenjodaro confirm this crop has been part of India’s agricultural identity for millennia. Interestingly, too much heat can actually reduce its oil quality, showing how sensitive it is to temperature shifts.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: What is the primary aim of the PARIVARTAN scheme?
options: Facilitating the replacement of old, high-pollution vehicles in the NCR
Promoting electric rickshaws for rural connectivity
questions.explain: By offering tax concessions and interest subventions, the government is incentivizing the move to cleaner BS-VI or electric commercial vehicles. It’s currently being rolled out specifically for the National Capital Region to address air quality concerns.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: The Open General Export Licence (OGEL) in India's defence sector is designed to:
options: Ban the export of all small arms
Limit defence trade to a maximum of two nations
Allow eligible exporters to bypass repeated authorizations for specific items
Make all exports subject to UN approval
questions.explain: Introduced in 2019, this framework acts as a one-time clearance, saving companies the paperwork of seeking permission for every individual shipment. The recent reforms have expanded its reach to almost all non-sensitive nations, significantly easing the path for Indian defence exporters.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: Sree Narayana Guru's philosophical message is best summarized by which of the following phrases?
options: 'One Caste, One Religion, One God for Mankind'
questions.explain: His movement centered on human dignity and equality, directly challenging the rigid caste-based exclusion of the time. The Aruvippuram event in 1888 is particularly famous as a symbolic defiance of the prevailing temple-entry restrictions.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: What is the primary function of the National Test House (NTH)?
options: Providing industrial testing, calibration, and quality evaluation
Setting foreign policy for scientific trade
questions.explain: Operating under the Consumer Affairs Ministry, this organization is India’s largest multidisciplinary laboratory for industry standards. They are even emerging as the pioneers for drone certification, which shows how they're adapting to new technological demands.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: The Javelin missile system is primarily categorized as what type of weapon?
questions.explain: The 'fire-and-forget' nature allows the operator to move to safety immediately after launching, which provides a massive tactical advantage. It’s an American-developed weapon that's become a benchmark for modern, shoulder-fired infantry defense.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: What does the 'Kamala' rice variety (DRR Dhan 100) aim to improve compared to traditional varieties?
options: Export potential exclusively to European markets
Grain production per panicle and stalk strength to prevent lodging
questions.explain: By modifying cytokinin metabolism, scientists managed to boost grain numbers while also ensuring the stalks stay sturdy against wind and rain. This is a great example of how genome editing can solve real-world agricultural problems like 'lodging'.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: Which specific Ministry acts as the nodal agency for the Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana, which recently marked 12 years of implementation?
questions.explain: Overseeing this massive financial inclusion drive is the Department of Financial Services, which falls under the Finance Ministry. You should note that this scheme is famously underpinned by the slogan 'Mera Khata – Bhagya Vidhata', reflecting its goal to bring formal banking to every Indian household.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: The PM SVANidhi scheme, which focuses on supporting street vendors, saw a key update regarding its operational timeline. When is the current extension set to conclude?
questions.explain: Policymakers have pushed the horizon for this initiative to March 2030, ensuring longer support for small-scale entrepreneurs. It's vital to remember that this scheme, originally launched in 2020 by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, provides collateral-free working capital loans to help vendors recover from pandemic-era financial stress.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: Regarding the new Banas Bio-CNG plant in Gujarat, what is the primary raw material processed to create organic fertilizer and clean energy?
questions.explain: Utilizing animal waste through anaerobic digestion, this plant demonstrates a clever approach to the circular economy. This project is quite significant because the National Dairy Development Board, established back in 1965, plays a crucial role in these rural development ventures to boost income for local livestock farmers.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: Hindalco Industries recently unveiled India's first plant for 'Superfine Precipitated Aluminium Trihydrate'. Which industry benefit is primarily served by this material?
questions.explain: Constructed in Karnataka, this facility produces a flame-retardant material essential for making cables and polymers safer during heat exposure. It's worth knowing that such innovations directly bolster the 'Aatmanirbhar Bharat' movement, reducing our reliance on imports for high-value specialty chemical products.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: In a bid to manage forex stability, how has the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) modified access to the FCNR(B) swap facility for larger transactions?
options: The window remains unchanged, but bank fees have been halved
It abolished all weekly constraints for transactions of any size
Swap access is now available on any day for transactions exceeding $100 million
Transactions above $10 million can now occur on daily windows
questions.explain: Granting banks greater flexibility, the central bank now allows these high-value swaps to bypass the usual weekly scheduling. You'll find this change particularly useful during volatile periods, as it helps banks manage surplus dollar liquidity more effectively without waiting for designated days.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: Which major insurer has introduced the ‘My Family Complete’ policy, a pioneering plan that includes pets under its coverage umbrella?
questions.explain: Setting a new trend in the industry, this Pune-based insurer is bundling human health benefits with pet-care facilities like emergency ambulance and liability support. This move is definitely one to watch, as it's the first time a major provider has unified coverage for family members and household pets into a single integrated plan.

questions.q: The Memorandum of Understanding signed between NABARD and NaBFID is intended to boost which specific economic sector?
options: Rural infrastructure and related value chains
questions.explain: By partnering together, these institutions aim to provide the long-term capital necessary to revitalize village connectivity, warehousing, and cold chains. Candidates should recall that NaBFID was established in 2021 specifically to act as a Development Finance Institution focused on fueling India's large-scale infrastructure ambitions.

questions.q: Who was appointed as the new Vice President and Auditor General of the World Bank Group in August 2026?
questions.explain: Stepping into this leadership role with decades of international experience, Keicho is set to oversee governance and risk management across the institution. Her career is quite notable, as she previously served at the Asian Development Bank before returning to help steer the World Bank’s internal integrity framework.

questions.q: ‘Samarthak’, the Indian Navy's first indigenous Multi-Purpose Vessel, was built by which corporate entity?
questions.explain: Constructed at the Kattupalli facility in Tamil Nadu, this vessel demonstrates the success of local naval engineering with over 75% indigenous components. It’s categorized as a versatile platform designed for testing modern naval weapons and sensors, fitting perfectly into the broader national goal of self-reliance.
